newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony unit to launch new game machine model.
newsitem.headline: Sony unit to launch new game machine model.

text.p: Sony Computer Entertainment Inc, a unit of Sony Corp, said on Thursday that it would launch a new version of its PlayStation game console next month to help it take advantage of end-of-year demand.

A company spokesman said the new model, to be launched on November 15, has fewer components and is easier to mass produce than the existing version, allowing Sony Entertainment to manufacture the product in bulk for the pre-Christmas sales rush.
However, he said that the pricing will remain at the current level of 19,800 yen.
The company also announced that aggregate shipments of PlayStation since the game machine's launch in December 1994 reached nine million units as of the end of October.

Of the total, domestic shipments of PlayStation reached four million units, while shipments to the United States and to Europe totalled 2.8 million and 2.2 million, respectively, the company said in a statement.
The company also said it would increase monthly production of the game machine from 900,000 to one million from November.
